title: The Civic Intelligence
description: The orbital intelligence that runs Lionrise and advises the player with ruthless clarity.

title: The Security Marshal
description: A decorated defender who believes sovereignty must be made credible.

title: The Habitat Engineer
description: A systems biologist responsible for air water and the fragile ecology of Lionrise.

title: The Labor Delegate
description: A construction robot elected to represent workers organic and synthetic.

title: The Education Minister
description: A relentless public communicator building schools and clean institutions.

title: The Industrialist
description: A brilliant investor who can smell an emerging monopoly through vacuum.

title: The Port Architect
description: A pilot and logistics savant who sees trade routes where others see empty space.

title: The Ambassador
description: An alien diplomat fluent in the threats hidden inside generous treaties.

title: The Living Network
description: A collective alien intelligence carrying the memory of a hundred displaced worlds.

title: The Young Lion
description: A fearless adolescent bug and unofficial voice of the station's next generation.
